positions.as_written: Identify the mechanism before planning a repair, because the mechanism predicts whether the repair will be loaded the same way again.
Assess alignment in any knee with compartment specific symptoms, since alignment is the mechanical variable with the largest effect per step.
Avoid quoting an ultimate load figure as though it predicted an individual injury.
